new_consequence: For each fixed Euclidean frequency the canonical Hessian minus the density-conjugated flat normal form has a finite translated-logarithmic weak cutoff limit. Its density row can have a nonzero finite value.
remaining_gap: The normal logarithmic compensator is not yet identified with all original local Weyl, classical and LLL shape terms. Their combined cutoff action must be evaluated before excluding the stated candidate expansion. Physical boundary data, causal constraints, nonlinear existence and all-sector stability remain open.
